headphone_eq.label: JM-1 逆均衡
headphone_eq.reference: JM-1 DF (saved canonical reference; no tilt or bass shelf)
headphone_eq.apply_to: both ears identically, once after all acoustic-response mixing
headphone_eq.normalization: DC follows the target inverse; no peak or loudness normalization
headphone_eq.endpoint_policy: hold first value to DC and last value to Nyquist
headphone_eq.limitation: Inverts the JM-1 target magnitude only; actual headphone/ear response is unmeasured.
headphone_eq.required_hrtf_profile: non-diffuse-field-equalized HRIR; do not enable over the existing native-DF SADIE II responses

audition_profile.note: RAW KEMAR 无扩散场均衡 · 近场刚球修正 · 最终双耳同一JM1逆均衡。椅背声源固定，后移上限2.5cm，后排横移受限。理想模型预测，近耳实物仍需测量。
